title: ZukuJS project manifest (zukujs.json)
description: Local ZukuJS CLI project file at the project root. Not a service schema and never packaged: only the `source` directory is archived. Packages follow the ZWF2/ZIP contract of @zuku/zwf (only `title` is passed to compileZip). Game fields map to the /api/v1 JUMP draft body in lib/jump-meta.mjs. Distinct from the Next2D jump-manifest schema and the ZWF2 container manifest.

name.description: Local slug; default output file name.

title.description: Counted in UTF-16 units (zwf truncates at 100); not whitespace-only.

source.description: Single directory under the project root; the only packaged tree.

entry.description: At the source root; the other index variant must not exist there.

game_id.description: Client game metadata, not the content ID. Default: game_<name with '-' replaced by '_'>.

genre.description: Omitted from the draft when absent.

platform.description: Declare only platforms the game actually supports. Default: pc only.

exclude.description: Exact source-relative paths; a directory excludes its subtree. No globs.
